title: Arrow Helper
description: Shows how many arrows you have. Useful for Drain Crystal PvP
body:
Adds a small indicator in the bottom-right corner of your screen that shows which type of arrow you currently have selected and how many you're carrying. 
This lets you keep track of your arrow count at a glance without digging through your inventory, which is useful in Drain Crystal PvP where you need to manage your supply on the fly during fast-paced exchanges.
